turns.user: What actions and deadlines does the environmental and social commitment plan set for P166685?

text: Source: the latest disclosed ESCP for EASP (record dated 2022-02-28; its cover and header still read 'June 9, 2020' / 'June 2020', like the 2020 and 2021 versions). Responsible entities are MEMD (PCU and its Health, Safety and Environment Unit), REA and UECCC; REA has since been folded into MEMD (the PAD refers to 'the former REA'), so its duties now sit with MEMD.

Reporting: consolidated quarterly E&S reports to the Bank from project effectiveness to completion; incidents and accidents with significant adverse effects (fatalities, serious injuries, SEA/SH, child labour, GBV) reported within 24 hours (pp. 4-5).

Institutions: PCU and PIU E&S staff recruited by March 2021 (REA: environmental and social safeguards specialists, a senior wayleaves officer and four wayleaves officers; UECCC: an E&S specialist) (1.1, pp. 5-6).

Assessments and contractors: sub-project ESIAs/ESMPs with mitigation measures completed and cleared two months before a sub-project starts, environmental audits annually (1.2, p. 6); contractor ESMPs, codes of conduct, labour, camp, HIV/AIDS, grievance and HSE plans two months before a sub-project is implemented (1.4, p. 7); permits and consents (1.5, 2021, p. 8).
Labour and safety (2.1-2.5, pp. 9-11): labour management procedures, workers' grievance mechanism, OHS measures, emergency preparedness and worker training, with completion dates given as 2025.

Community and land (pp. 12-16): traffic and road safety (2025), community health and safety (2021), GBV/SEA measures (2025), security personnel assessment by June 2021; resettlement under the RPF with RAPs before works and RAP monitoring throughout the project (5.1-5.4).

Other (pp. 17-23): biodiversity measures by December 2021 (6.1); vulnerable and marginalized groups plans (7.1-7.2, 2025); chance finds and cultural heritage procedures (8.1-8.2, 2025); UECCC to establish and maintain an Environmental and Social Management System for financial intermediation, with organizational capacity and a senior management representative (9.1-9.4, 2025).

Caveat: many completion dates (2021, 2025) predate the project's actual effectiveness (July 2023) and its June 2027 closing date; the disclosed ESCP has not been updated to reflect them, so the dates should be confirmed with the team.
